answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 4436 Country: India Title: Aslk, I want to know the regarding the food product aginamoto(testing powder) which is generally used in chinees food.Can you plz let me know is haram or halal to use coz i heard tht prok is used in making on this one and regariding mushrooms also.Please clarify Question: Aslk, I want to know the regarding the food product aginamoto(testing powder) which is generally used in chinees food.Can you plz let me know is haram or halal to use coz i heard tht prok is used in making on this one and regariding mushrooms also.Please clarify Answer ID: 4436 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 4364/434=M1429) (1) We have no knowledge about ingredients of "aginamoto" If you surely know or it is proved by an Islamic witness that pork is included in its ingredients, then you should refrain from using it. No definite ruling can be given until it is proved by research. (2) First, please, explain what ?mushroom? is, so that we can reply you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
